note: New knowledge pack (ticket #808, frontend wave 4). Fences: reactivity-facts owns reactivity MECHANISM (kernel/recompute/disposal/staleness/scheduling), unrelated to how data gets connected in the first place; state-model-rules owns app-tier state ARCHITECTURE judgment generally, unrelated to one specific wiring decision; persistence-facts owns what gets WRITTEN to storage and when, unrelated to how data gets wired into a live element or across a bridge. n01-n03 fence reactivity-facts, n04-n06 fence state-model-rules, n07-n09 fence persistence-facts, n10-n12 are unrelated-domain no-trigger cases.
